purpose: A small complete fixed-axis software integration case, independent of historical R0 and customer parts.

resource_scope.machine: reference XYZ, rotary axes fixed; not an identified factory controller
resource_scope.work_offset: G54 with zero translation for the first probe; origin at a stock top-face corner (0,0,0), X along the 8 mm edge, Y along the 6 mm edge, Z upward
resource_scope.fixture: proposed side clamping with unobstructed underside; actual clamping and collision validation deferred

selection_reasons: Only one operation, one tool, one setup and one feature, so failures can be isolated.
Unequal stock lengths and an off-center hole expose axis swaps, origin shifts and mirror errors.
An independent box-minus-cylinder target has simple hole diameter, position, breakthrough and exterior checks.
The full declared stock fits the current conservative grid gate at 0.025 mm; admission still requires measured runtime and numerical validation.
The same family can add a second hole, then a pocket/slot, then orientation; size and feature complexity are tested separately.

negative_cases_after_selection.change: Shift the NC hole center by +0.25 mm in X; keep original target unchanged.
Stop the drill above the stock bottom; keep original target unchanged.
Use a different drill diameter; keep original target unchanged.

route_after_s1: Increase stock size to historical R0, 30 x 20 x 5 mm / diameter 4, without adding feature types; qualify a resource-feasible representation independently.
Add multiple holes and basic slot, step and pocket operations one capability at a time.
Validate one simple real single part from the existing customer drawings.
Add indexed 3+2 operations and then continuous five-axis on simple test geometry.
Extend to complex single parts and multiple setups before assemblies.
